spec.name: M5.BirthSearch.birth_spec
spec.statement: ∀ (T lower B : ℕ) (C : ℕ → ℤ), (∃ N : ℕ, N ≤ B ∧ lower ≤ N ∧ T ∣ N ∧ 0 < C N) → ∃ b : ℕ, M5.BirthSearch.birth T lower B C = some b ∧ b ≤ B ∧ lower ≤ b ∧ T ∣ b ∧ 0 < C b ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, lower ≤ N → T ∣ N → 0 < C N → b ≤ N
queries: Finset min prime membership lower bound
spec.guidance: The witness makes candidates nonempty. Use Finset.min'_mem for its bounds/positivecount. For any positive candidateN, if N<=B apply min'_le; otherwise b<=B<N. Unfold birth at the proved nonempty case. This proves minimum even against orders beyond the search interval. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement.

spec.name: M5.BirthSearch.birth_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (T lower B : ℕ) (C : ℕ → ℤ) (Valid : ℕ → Prop), (∀ N : ℕ, Valid N → lower ≤ N ∧ T ∣ N) → (∀ N : ℕ, lower ≤ N → T ∣ N → (0 < C N ↔ Valid N)) → (∃ N : ℕ, N ≤ B ∧ Valid N) → ∃ b : ℕ, M5.BirthSearch.birth T lower B C = some b ∧ Valid b ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, Valid N → b ≤ N
queries: Finset min prime membership lower bound
spec.guidance: Convert the bounded valid witness to birth_spec premises using necessary bounds and exactcount. Convert returned positive count to validity. Every validN satisfies lower/period conditions and positivecount, so the global minimum property applies. Later instantiate C with original arithmeticC, Valid with physical realizability, and bounded witness from28/A; do not assume these in the final M5 theorem. spec.name: M5.BirthSearch.birth_none_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (T lower B : ℕ) (C : ℕ → ℤ), M5.BirthSearch.birth T lower B C = none ↔ ∀ N : ℕ, N ≤ B → lower ≤ N → T ∣ N → C N ≤ 0
queries: Finset min prime membership lower bound
spec.guidance: Unfold birth and candidates. None iff candidatefinset is empty; a candidate requires all range/lower/divisibility/positivecount conditions. Use integer not_lt to express nonpositive. This is a finite-interval statement only, not an all-order nonrealizability claim by itself. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement.
